mapper.select: SELECT id, service_name, direction, purpose, caller_name, authorization_scope, authorization_scope_value, owner_id, status, created_at, updated_at FROM sys_interface_service WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_interface_service SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ENABLED'
UPDATE sys_interface_service SET authorization_scope = #{authorizationScope}, authorization_scope_value = #{authorizationScopeValue, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
